newsitem.title: ITALY: LIFFE says relists Dec 97 Btp with 8.0 pct coupon.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE says relists Dec 97 Btp with 8.0 pct coupon.

text.p: LIFFE said on Wednesday it was relisting the December 1997 delivery month of its Italian government bond (Btp) contract with effect from Thursday May 22 with an 8.0 percent coupon.
The Dec 1997 Btp contract was suspended on March 18 this year pending a review of the contract specification amd specifically the notional coupon level.
"Following the review the board has resolved that the coupon be reduced from 12 percent to 8.0 percent with effect from the December 1997 delivery month," a LIFFE statement received in Milan said.
Daniel Hodson, LIFFE chief executive, said in the statement the decison to adopt an 8.0 percent notional coupon came after considering technical requirements of clients and members.
"The decision reflects the trend of falling Italian yields, which started with a sharp decrease two years ago and is still ongoing," Hodson said.
"LIFFE will continue to closely follow the developments in the rationalisation process of the Italian cash and repo markets, as well as developments in yield levels," he said.
